cat > /usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop-setup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
attach_loop() {
    dev="$1"
    image="$2"
    if losetup -j "$image" | grep -q "^${dev}:"; then
        return 0
    fi
    if losetup "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "$dev is already attached to another backing file" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    losetup "$dev" "$image"
}
modprobe loop
attach_loop /dev/loop0 /var/lib/lvm-data/pv1.img
attach_loop /dev/loop1 /var/lib/lvm-data/pv2.img
udevadm settle
pvscan --cache
vgchange -ay data_vg
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop-setup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/lvm-data-loop-setup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop devices for data_vg
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop-setup
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon -v /usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop-setup /etc/systemd/system/lvm-data-loop-setup.service || true
printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/data_vg-data_lv /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=lvm-data-loop-setup.service,x-systemd.after=lvm-data-loop-setup.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable lvm-data-loop-setup.service
systemctl start lvm-data-loop-setup.service
mount -a
systemctl is-enabled lvm-data-loop-setup.service; systemctl is-active lvm-data-loop-setup.service; findmnt /srv/data
